§6Information Screen§f

§aA slim panel that shows real-time RF stats from any adjacent power block.§f

The §bInformation Screen§f sits flush against any face (only §e0.05 blocks§f deep) and displays live energy data from any RF/FE-compatible block. Useful for monitoring input, output, and total storage at a glance.

§9Right-click§f with a wrench to cycle display modes, storage capacity, percentage full, and RF/t flow rates. Works with Powercells, standard energy cells, or any FE block.

§6Crafting§f: §b3 Glass Panes§f (top) + §b2 Redstone§f (sides) + §b1 Machine Base§f (center)

§9Note:§f Place multiple screens on different sides of one Powercell to monitor input, output, and total storage simultaneously.
